lede: Indiana carries the stronger underlying team rating — +9.6 against +4.9, a 4.6-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Michigan +10.0 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Indiana winning 75% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is kicking, where Indiana leads Michigan by 74 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 83% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
